roadmap.name: Data-analysis
roadmap.description: Lộ trình trở thành Data Analyst - người phân tích dữ liệu để tạo insights hỗ trợ quyết định kinh doanh. Bắt đầu từ nền tảng toán/statistics, phát triển kỹ năng SQL, Python, visualization, BI tools, đến advanced analytics và storytelling với data.

stages.name: Foundation
stages.description: Nắm vững nền tảng toán học, statistics cơ bản và tư duy phân tích.

skills.name: Mathematics for Data Analysis
whatYouWillLearn: Applied math for business: growth rates, percentages, ratios
Number sense: estimation, mental math, reasonableness checks

nextSkill.name: Statistics Fundamentals
nextSkill.description: Nắm vững statistics cơ bản cho phân tích dữ liệu.

skills.name: Statistics Fundamentals
whatYouWillLearn: Descriptive statistics: mean, median, mode, range
Measures of spread: variance, standard deviation, IQR
When to use which statistical measure

nextSkill.name: Excel & Spreadsheet Analysis
nextSkill.description: Bắt đầu phân tích dữ liệu với Excel.

skills.name: Excel & Spreadsheet Analysis
whatYouWillLearn: Excel fundamentals: cells, sheets, formatting, navigation
Formulas: SUM, AVERAGE, COUNT, COUNTA, COUNTBLANK
Lookup functions: VLOOKUP, HLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, XLOOKUP
Conditional functions: SUMIF, COUNTIF, AVERAGEIF, nested IF
Text functions: LEFT, RIGHT, MID, CONCATENATE, TRIM, LEN
Date functions: TODAY, NOW, DATEDIF, EOMONTH, YEAR/MONTH/DAY
Pivot Tables: creating, summarizing, grouping, filtering
Data validation: input rules, dropdown lists
Sorting và filtering: basic, custom, advanced
Data cleaning in Excel: duplicates, text-to-columns, find-replace
Charts: bar, line, pie, scatter, combo
What-If Analysis: Goal Seek, Scenario Manager, Data Tables
Macros basics: recording, running simple macros
Power Query basics: importing, transforming data

nextSkill.name: Analytical Thinking & Business Acumen
nextSkill.description: Phát triển tư duy phân tích và hiểu biết kinh doanh.

stages.name: Business & Analytical Skills
stages.description: Phát triển tư duy phân tích và hiểu biết kinh doanh.

skills.name: Analytical Thinking & Problem Solving
whatYouWillLearn: Critical thinking: evaluating information, distinguishing fact vs opinion
Problem decomposition: breaking down complex problems
Root cause analysis: 5 Whys, Fishbone diagram
MECE principle: Mutually Exclusive, Collectively Exhaustive
Structured problem-solving: issue trees, hypothesis trees

nextSkill.name: Business Fundamentals
nextSkill.description: Nắm vững kiến thức kinh doanh cơ bản.

skills.name: Business Fundamentals
whatYouWillLearn: Business models: B2B, B2C, B2G, marketplace, subscription
Financial metrics: revenue, profit, margin, ROI, CAC, LTV
Marketing metrics: conversion, CTR, CPM, CPA
Sales metrics: pipeline, win rate, deal size, velocity
Product metrics: DAU/MAU, retention, churn, engagement
Operations metrics: efficiency, throughput, cycle time
Customer metrics: NPS, CSAT, CES, churn rate
Business terminology: common terms across functions

nextSkill.name: SQL & Database Fundamentals
nextSkill.description: Học SQL để truy cập và phân tích dữ liệu.

stages.name: SQL & Database
stages.description: Thành thạo SQL để truy vấn và phân tích dữ liệu từ database.

skills.name: SQL Fundamentals
whatYouWillLearn: SQL overview: what is SQL, RDBMS concepts
FROM clause: single table, table aliases
IN, BETWEEN, LIKE, IS NULL operators
ORDER BY: sorting ascending, descending, multiple columns
Aggregate functions: COUNT, SUM, AVG, MIN, MAX
GROUP BY: grouping data, aggregate results
Creating tables: CREATE TABLE, data types, constraints

nextSkill.name: SQL Intermediate
nextSkill.description: Nâng cao kỹ năng SQL với joins và subqueries.

skills.name: SQL Intermediate
whatYouWillLearn: JOINs: INNER JOIN, LEFT JOIN, RIGHT JOIN, FULL OUTER JOIN
Window functions: LAG, LEAD, FIRST_VALUE, LAST_VALUE
Window functions: SUM, AVG, COUNT OVER partitions
CASE WHEN: conditional logic in queries
String functions: CONCAT, SUBSTRING, UPPER, LOWER, TRIM

nextSkill.name: Database Design & Modeling
nextSkill.description: Hiểu cách thiết kế database hiệu quả.

skills.name: Database Design & Modeling
whatYouWillLearn: Database design process: requirements → conceptual → logical → physical
Data types selection: choosing appropriate types
Foreign keys: ON DELETE, ON UPDATE actions
Data warehouse concepts: star schema, snowflake schema
Database tools: DBeaver, pgAdmin, MySQL Workbench

nextSkill.name: Python for Data Analysis
nextSkill.description: Bắt đầu học Python cho phân tích dữ liệu.

stages.name: Programming for Data Analysis
stages.description: Học Python và các libraries để phân tích dữ liệu hiệu quả.

skills.name: Python Fundamentals
whatYouWillLearn: Python basics: variables, data types, operators
Data structures: lists, dictionaries, sets, tuples
String methods: split, join, replace, strip, format
Modules và packages: import, pip install
Jupyter Notebook: cells, markdown, execution order
Google Colab: cloud notebooks, GPU access
Python for data analysis: why Python over other languages

nextSkill.name: Pandas
nextSkill.description: Học Pandas cho data manipulation.

skills.name: Pandas
whatYouWillLearn: Reading data: read_csv, read_excel, read_sql, read_json
Writing data: to_csv, to_excel, to_sql, to_json
Basic operations: head, tail, info, describe, shape
Missing data: isnull, dropna, fillna, interpolate

nextSkill.name: NumPy
nextSkill.description: Học NumPy cho numerical computing.

skills.name: NumPy
whatYouWillLearn: Array creation: array, zeros, ones, arange, linspace
Random number generation: rand, randint, normal
Array indexing: slicing, boolean indexing, fancy indexing
Linear algebra: dot, matmul, transpose, inverse
Statistical operations: mean, std, var, min, max, percentile
NumPy vs Python lists: performance comparison

nextSkill.name: Data Visualization (Python)
nextSkill.description: Học visualization với Python.

stages.name: Data Visualization
stages.description: Tạo visualizations và dashboards để communicate insights.

skills.name: Data Visualization (Python)
whatYouWillLearn: Matplotlib plots: line, bar, scatter, histogram, box
Customization: colors, styles, labels, titles, legends
Seaborn plots: relplot, catplot, displot, pairplot
Seaborn themes: darkgrid, whitegrid, dark, white
Plotly express:快速创建 interactive charts
Choosing the right chart type for data
Visualization best practices: clarity, accuracy, efficiency
Color theory: sequential, diverging, qualitative palettes

nextSkill.name: Tableau
nextSkill.description: Học Tableau cho BI và visualization.

skills.name: Tableau
whatYouWillLearn: Tableau Desktop: interface, connecting to data
Data sources: Excel, CSV, databases, cloud sources
Data preparation: joins, unions, blending, data types
Marks card: color, size, label, detail, tooltip
Chart types: bar, line, scatter, maps, treemap, heatmap
Dashboard actions: filter, highlight, URL, parameter

nextSkill.name: Power BI
nextSkill.description: Học Power BI cho BI và visualization.

skills.name: Power BI
whatYouWillLearn: Power BI Desktop: interface, data connections
Data sources: Excel, SQL, web, APIs
Power Query: transforming data, M language basics
DAX functions: CALCULATE, FILTER, ALL, RELATED
Visualizations: bar, line, card, table, matrix, map
Power BI Service: workspaces, apps, scheduled refresh
Power BI Mobile: viewing dashboards on mobile
Power BI tips: performance, design best practices
Power BI vs Tableau: comparison, when to use which

nextSkill.name: Statistics for Data Analysis
nextSkill.description: Áp dụng statistics nâng cao vào phân tích.

stages.name: Statistics & Analytics
stages.description: Áp dụng statistics và analytics techniques nâng cao.

skills.name: Statistics for Data Analysis
whatYouWillLearn: Hypothesis testing: null hypothesis, alternative hypothesis
Type I and Type II errors
A/B testing: statistical significance, sample size
Time series basics: trend, seasonality, stationarity

nextSkill.name: Advanced Analytics with Python
nextSkill.description: Áp dụng techniques nâng cao với Python.

skills.name: Advanced Analytics with Python
whatYouWillLearn: Linear regression: model building, evaluation metrics
Decision trees: Random Forest, feature importance
Metrics: accuracy, precision, recall, F1, AUC-ROC, RMSE, MAE
Time series forecasting: ARIMA, Prophet basics
Natural Language Processing basics: text analysis

nextSkill.name: Data Wrangling & ETL
nextSkill.description: Làm sạch và transform dữ liệu.

skills.name: Data Wrangling & ETL
whatYouWillLearn: Data quality assessment: accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness
Missing data strategies: deletion, imputation, flagging
Data type conversions: strings, dates, numbers
Date parsing: various formats, time zones
Outlier detection: IQR method, Z-score, visualization
Merge và join operations: combining datasets
Reshaping data: wide to long, long to wide
ETL tools overview: Apache Airflow, dbt, Talend

nextSkill.name: Machine Learning Basics
nextSkill.description: Nắm vững basics machine learning.

stages.name: Machine Learning Basics
stages.description: Nắm vững fundamentals machine learning cho data analysis.

skills.name: Supervised Learning
whatYouWillLearn: Supervised learning overview: labeled data, prediction
Random Forest: ensemble methods, feature importance
Model evaluation regression: MSE, RMSE, MAE, R²
Model evaluation classification: accuracy, precision, recall, F1
ROC curve và AUC: threshold analysis

nextSkill.name: Unsupervised Learning
nextSkill.description: Học unsupervised learning cho clustering và patterns.

skills.name: Unsupervised Learning
whatYouWillLearn: Unsupervised learning overview: no labels, pattern discovery
K-Means clustering: choosing K, elbow method, silhouette score
Anomaly detection: Isolation Forest, local outlier factor
Practical applications: when to use which method

nextSkill.name: Business Intelligence & Reporting
nextSkill.description: Xây dựng BI systems và reporting.

stages.name: Business Intelligence & Reporting
stages.description: Xây dựng hệ thống BI, reporting và dashboarding.

skills.name: BI Systems & Architecture
whatYouWillLearn: BI architecture: data sources, ETL, data warehouse, analytics, visualization
Data warehouse concepts: OLAP vs OLTP
Dimensional modeling: star schema, snowflake schema
Facts và dimensions: designing for analytics
ETL vs ELT: choosing the right approach
Data pipeline design: batch vs streaming
BI tools comparison: Tableau, Power BI, Looker, Metabase
BI success factors: user adoption, data quality, alignment

nextSkill.name: Dashboard Design
nextSkill.description: Thiết kế dashboard hiệu quả.

skills.name: Dashboard Design
whatYouWillLearn: Dashboard design principles: clarity, accuracy, efficiency
Choosing the right visualization for data
Dashboard vs report: differences, use cases
Common dashboard mistakes: clutter, misleading visuals
Design tools: Figma, Adobe XD for wireframing
User feedback: iterating on dashboard design

nextSkill.name: Storytelling with Data
nextSkill.description: Kể chuyện hiệu quả với dữ liệu.

stages.name: Communication & Career
stages.description: Kỹ năng giao tiếp, storytelling và phát triển sự nghiệp.

skills.name: Storytelling with Data
whatYouWillLearn: Common storytelling mistakes: too much data, no narrative
Practice: presenting findings to different audiences
Tools for storytelling: slides, dashboards, notebooks

nextSkill.name: Presentation & Communication
nextSkill.description: Trình bày và giao tiếp findings hiệu quả.

skills.name: Presentation & Communication
whatYouWillLearn: Handling Q&A: anticipating questions, staying composed
Cross-functional communication: with engineering, product, marketing
Data request management: understanding, scoping, delivering
Remote communication: best practices for virtual presentations

nextSkill.name: Career Development
nextSkill.description: Phát triển sự nghiệp Data Analyst.

skills.name: Career Development
whatYouWillLearn: Data Analyst career paths: analyst → senior → lead → manager
Specialization paths: analytics engineer, data scientist, BI developer
Building portfolio: case studies, projects, GitHub
Resume tips: highlighting impact, quantifying achievements
Interview preparation: SQL tests, case studies, behavioral
SQL interview practice: common patterns, optimization
Certifications: Google Data Analytics, Microsoft PL-300, IBM Data Analyst
Data communities: meetups, conferences, online forums
Salary negotiation: market research, negotiation tactics
Mentorship: finding mentors, being a mentor
Staying current: new tools, techniques, trends

nextSkill.name: Career Ready!
nextSkill.description: Hoàn thành lộ trình Data Analyst và sẵn sàng cho sự nghiệp.
